description: Extract a list of URLs in one job, each as Markdown/text/HTML, results in input order; invalid URLs are reported, never billed. Waits up to wait_seconds: returns results if done, else the job id for get_batch_status. Per successful page: normal 1cr, advanced 1cr, ultra 2cr; failed/skipped pages free. Obeys robots.txt. Max URLs: Free 10, PAYG 50, Project 100, Bootstrap 500, Startup/Growth 1k.

idempotency_key.description: Optional; the same key within 24h returns the original job.

max_content_chars.description: Clip each page's content to this many chars (default 4000).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish (default 30).

webhook_url.description: Optional https URL that gets a signed POST when the job ends; secret returned once as webhook_secret.

name: batch_extract
title: Batch Extract
